import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; import { CheckSquare, Target, Calendar, TrendingUp, BookOpen, Plus, Clock, ArrowRight, Zap, Star, Award } from 'lucide-react'; const Dashboard = () => { const { user } = useAuth(); const [stats, setStats] = useState({ tasks: { total: 12, completed: 8, pending: 4 }, goals: { total: 5, completed: 2 } }); const [recentTasks] = useState([ { _id: '1', title: 'Complete project proposal', dueDate: new Date(), status: 'in-progress', priority: 'high' }, { _id: '2', title: 'Review team feedback', dueDate: new Date(), status: 'pending', priority: 'medium' }, { _id: '3', title: 'Update documentation', dueDate: new Date(), status: 'completed', priority: 'low' } ]); const quickActions = [ { title: 'Add New Task', icon: , link: '/tasks', color: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 border-blue-100', description: 'Create a new task' }, { title: 'Set New Goal', icon: , link: '/goals', color: 'bg-green-50 text-green-600 border-green-100', description: 'Define your milestone' }, { title: 'View Calendar', icon: , link: '/calendar', color: 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 border-purple-100', description: 'Check your schedule' }, { title: 'Write Journal', icon: , link: '/diary', color: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border-orange-100', description: 'Capture your thoughts' } ]; const statCards = [ { title: 'Total Tasks', value: stats.tasks.total, icon: , color: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 border-blue-100', change: '+12%', changeColor: 'text-green-600' }, { title: 'Completed Today', value: stats.tasks.completed, icon: , color: 'bg-green-50 text-green-600 border-green-100', change: '+8%', changeColor: 'text-green-600' }, { title: 'Active Goals', value: stats.goals.total - stats.goals.completed, icon: , color: 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 border-purple-100', change: '+3%', changeColor: 'text-green-600' }, { title: 'Success Rate', value: `${Math.round((stats.tasks.completed / stats.tasks.total) * 100)}%`, icon: , color: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border-orange-100', change: '+15%', changeColor: 'text-green-600' } ]; return (
